Name: Giant Chicken Plushies
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds 5 new plushies to decorate your home :)

I made plushies for each chicken: white, brown, void, blue and golden!

You can find them in shops, festivals and the prize machine.

How to get each plushie:
[spoiler]
White [size=3]Chicken[/size]: Egg Festival.

Brown Chicken: Stardew Valley Fair.

Void [size=3]Chicken[/size]: Krobus' Shop.

Blue [size=3]Chicken[/size]: Marnie's Shop (unlocks after Shane's 8 heart event).

Golden [size=3]Chicken[/size]: Prize Machine after 25 tickets.

[/spoiler]
Credits to:
ConcernedApe for creating cute chickens!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] and [color=#616161][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/205391183]Tomokisan1[/url][/color] for making this mod possible![/size]
